names: explicit pause stores the complete latest metadata/source package and resume attaches it once without native upload/create/close
held strict Resume disarm cannot attach metadata or enable editing before transaction completion
Resume disarm quota abort retains eligible checkpoint but never attaches old metadata
unsupported strict durability never disarms or attaches the saved B package
durably committed disarm with lost local owner acknowledgement leaves no attach and a fresh owner cannot reuse eligibility
ordinary active B debounce never creates Resume qualification and an abrupt reload rejects it
metadata-only edit after Resume keeps identical native fingerprint but old suspend metadata is ineligible on reload
Suspend transaction abort preserves current B metadata and leaves its freeze authoritative
Cancel during package validation wins over an older Resume and preserves checkpoint without attaching it
Finish during package validation wins and an old Resume cannot reopen the retired decision
native fingerprint mismatch rejects before disarm and leaves all stored records unchanged
corrupted complete package rejects without disarm, import or metadata attachment
a second editing epoch can explicitly suspend its new complete metadata before the next Resume
present malformed reserved Resume journals are not treated as absent and overwritten by Suspend
corrupted saved/dirty/provenance metadata outside ZIP cannot be accepted as the complete suspend checkpoint
